title: MapOS theme manifest v2
description: A question a user can switch on, and the sources that answer it. A theme is not a dataset: the same theme is drawn from Eurostat across Europe and from a national register inside one country, and the renderer picks per territory. See §23 of the roadmap.

unit.description: The unit the theme is expressed in after normalisation, not the unit any one source publishes.

normalization.description: How a source value is converted onto the theme's unit. A source that already publishes in the theme's unit is not converted again.

directionGoodBad.description: Chooses the colour ramp direction rather than a per-theme palette.

classBreaks.description: Fixed global bounds, when comparability across viewports matters more than local contrast. Absent means quantiles computed over the whole series.

role.description: `primary` is the continental fill, `detail` a finer source that takes over where it exists, `point` is drawn on top at high zoom instead of being coloured in.

themeMapping.description: How this source's field becomes the theme's unit.

perCapitaDatasetId.description: Population series to divide by when the theme is per-capita and the source publishes counts.

disclosure.description: The caveat that belongs behind an InfoTip: what makes a comparison across this theme unsafe.

i18n.description: Translations of the reader-facing strings, keyed by two-letter language. The top-level fields are the English fallback.
